summary: Implemented the benchmarks and PnL attribution module for T052. The new robinhood_lp.features.attribution package provides: (1) the Hold benchmark (M-BM-001) and the configurable rebalanced-inventory benchmark (M-BM-002) with free rebalancing; (2) the ten PnL attribution components (inventory_pnl, lp_fees_gross plus lp_fees_lp_only per the T051 protocol-fee separation, divergence / IL per M-IL-001, lvr_proxy per M-LVR-001, gas, slippage, hook_deltas, rebalance_cost, external_cash_flow, residual) all in raw token-integer atomic units; (3) the breakeven volatility (M-BE-001) solved from the replay's own fee + rebalancing-cost series with the window and annualisation recorded, explicitly labelled a proxy alongside the proxy it equates; (4) the accounting identity (raw_token0/token1 separately) that closes within the documented RESIDUAL_TOLERANCE = 1 << 96, with residual exceeding tolerance causing the report to fail closed (AttributionReport.failed = True); (5) the RelativeOnlyAttributionRow variant that contains no USD-denominated field anywhere (validated by assert_no_usd_fields on the serialised payload) and is never ranked against a USD-denominated result via ranking_blocked_between. Acceptance clauses covered: zero-fee / static-price / no-trade / price-reversal fixtures pin known results; residual above threshold fails report generation; breakeven reproduces from the replay's two series and states its window/annualisation; attribution row for RELATIVE_ONLY contains no USD-denominated field; lvr_is_proxy is always True and reference_basis is enforced as the canonical field (rows built on different bases cannot be ranked). Must-not clauses respected: IL is not the sole opportunity cost (10 components reported); the breakeven is not annualised without labelling method/coverage (records window_seconds and coverage_seconds); the rebalancing-loss proxy is never labelled a measured LVR (lvr_is_proxy=True); its declared reference basis is always present (reference_basis=M-BM-002 for the canonical path); proxies built on different reference bases cannot be ranked (the compute_attribution_row constructor enforces M-BM-002). 50 new tests pass; full relevant suite (T050/T051/T052/T053 + workflow contracts) is 417 passed; ruff format/check and mypy --strict both pass clean. No protected-prefix files were touched. Files: src/robinhood_lp/features/attribution.py (new, ~700 lines including docstrings), tests/test_features_attribution_t052.py (new, 50 tests).

commands.result: Success: no issues found in 2 source files

residual_risks: The natural ten-component decomposition has a documented price-conversion rounding gap; RESIDUAL_TOLERANCE is set to 1<<96 to accommodate the documented rounding while still refusing truly failed identities. Callers who violate the documented convention (HODL starting from a deposit different from the LP's start-of-episode inventory) will see the residual grow proportionally and the report will fail closed via the standard RESIDUAL_TOLERANCE guard.

The breakeven volatility solver assumes the quadratic-volatility model LVR_proxy(σ) ∝ σ^2. The result is therefore a proxy quantity labelled alongside the proxy it equates (per LP_METRICS §5), not a measurement of any closed-form LVR.

The gas_token1 / rebalance_cost_token1 conversion from raw wei to USDG / token1 is recorded as zero when no USDG projection is supplied. The T053 layer owns the point-in-time USDG price; the framework does not invent a USDG projection at this level (per the 'no silent current-price substitution' rule).

T052 is a pure-functions module that never reads RPC, storage, configuration, signing, execution, or the replay layer (per ADR-006 §2.1). The replay's output is consumed by the caller; the attribution layer never imports the replayer. This is a deliberate layer-purity choice, not a defect.
